findings.issue: H4518 הַמְּנַקִּיֹּת is a bowl/basin; «jarras» are pitchers.
H7184 קְשׂוֹת is a jug/jar (construct plural); «tazones» are bowls.
H3709 כַּף stays open (palm/pan/spoon); «cucharas» selects spoon.
H5262 הַנֶּסֶךְ is the libation; «derrame» names a pour/spill.
עָלָיו is 3ms; «ella» matches Spanish «mesa». Same referent.

notes: H4518 and H7184 are rendered as each other’s vessel.
